lines.text: This is the Sun lens of SolarLayout Rooftop. It shows where the sun stands over your roof, and what it shades.
When you play the day, the shadows move across the roof hour by hour, and the sun's height and bearing are shown for every hour.
The engine's own shadow outlines can be drawn over the view, and they follow the hour, so you can check what you see against what is calculated.
You can look at the solstices, the equinox, or any date you choose.
The shade map colours every module by its shading over the whole year, and the losses are given as near, electrical and far shading.
It is free, with no account needed, at rooftop dot solarlayout dot app.
